honest_gaps: Source is the OPDA Performance-Agreement PDF (the populated PBB measures tables), not a budget-book 'Volume III'; Cincinnati's FY26-27 budget Volumes I/II (Operating/Capital, fetched and verified at vendorselfservice.cincinnati-oh.gov/sites/budget/assets/) contain only a performance-measure glossary, no populated tables.
Targets/actuals live in the CincyInsights dashboards (data.cincinnati-oh.gov); this file banks the agreement-level service/goal/measure structure from the FY2027 PDF.
Parser is page-local: multi-page measure blocks could in principle be missed; 142 measures across 23 departments captured (raw parser JSON retained).
extraction_notes: Structure per block: Select a Service -> City Goal -> Select a Goal -> [Volume|Effectiveness|Efficiency|Output|Input] Measure -> measure name. page = PDF page number.
